title: ElementsClaw Fuses Large Atomic Models and LLMs to Guide Synthesis of 4 New Superconductors
aiSystem: ElementsClaw (Large Atomic Model + LLM Agentic Orchestrator)
whyItMatters: By orchestrating Large Atomic Models with LLM semantic reasoning, ElementsClaw screened 2.4M crystals in 28 GPU-hours and guided wet-lab synthesis of 4 newly confirmed superconductors (Zr3ScRe8, HfZrRe4, Zr4VRe7, Hf21Re25).
summary: Posted on April 26, 2026 (arXiv:2604.23758), Mingze Li, Yu Rong, Songyou Li, and collaborators introduced ElementsClaw, an agentic materials-discovery framework coupling an LLM reasoning orchestrator with fine-tuned Large Atomic Models (Elements) for high-fidelity atomistic property computation. Scaling across 2.4 million stable crystal structures in just 28 GPU-hours, the system rediscovered 66 known superconductors absent from SuperCon3D, flagged 68,000 high-confidence candidates, and guided experimental laboratory synthesis of four previously unconfirmed superconductors: Zr3ScRe8 (Tc = 6.8 K), HfZrRe4 (6.7 K), Zr4VRe7 (5.1 K, correcting an erroneous orthorhombic phase assignment to hexagonal), and Hf21Re25 (3.0 K).
technicalHighlights: Synergized LLM high-level scientific planning with fine-tuned Large Atomic Models (LAMs) for fast, physically grounded crystal screening.
Screened >2.4 million stable crystals in 28 GPU-hours and rediscovered 66 experimentally verified superconductors missing from SuperCon3D.
Guided wet-lab synthesis and confirmation of four novel superconducting compounds (Zr3ScRe8 at 6.8 K, HfZrRe4 at 6.7 K, Zr4VRe7 at 5.1 K, Hf21Re25 at 3.0 K).
caveats: Currently an arXiv preprint undergoing community audit; all four newly synthesized compounds are conventional low-Tc superconductors (3.0–6.8 K) rather than high-temperature or ambient-pressure breakthroughs.

scoreRationale.foundational: Demonstrates closed-loop agentic fusion of Large Atomic Models and LLMs moving from computational prediction to lab-synthesized superconductors.
scoreRationale.ripple: Provides an actionable blueprint for autonomous quantum-materials discovery across catalysts, thermoelectrics, and superconductors.
scoreRationale.verification: Includes experimental lab synthesis and Tc measurements for four new compounds, scored conservatively pending journal peer review and independent lab replication.
scoreRationale.velocity: Evaluated 2.4 million crystal structures in 28 GPU-hours before guiding targeted experimental synthesis.
